placements.why: The content concerns deployment gating and signed release manifest requirements — an architectural/infrastructure organizational category that nothing existing covers. This is the first envelope in the repo, so strata starts empty and this content calls for an Architecture category to hold deployment-infrastructure decisions.
placements.title: Deployment and Release Infrastructure
placements.theme: Organizational decisions governing deployment infrastructure, release safety, and artifact integrity

placements.title: Signed release manifests become mandatory for Meridian deployments
placements.theme: Deployment safety requires signed release manifests before any Meridian deploy reaches staging or production, prompted by unsigned artifacts that previously breached staging
placements.why: All three segments support the theme of mandatory signed manifests as a deployment gate: src-1 issues the directive that every Meridian deployment requires a signed release manifest, src-2 supplies the motivating incident of two unsigned artifacts reaching staging, and src-3 restates the decision's key parameters (gate, scope, owner). No existing leaf holds this theme.
